items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: page.tsx header h1 'Equipment' (plural-ish mass noun, acceptable) with no buttons at all; zero primary actions, no export. Passes the 'at most one' limit.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Table is in the first viewport (firstTableTop 157) and no KPI cards, but there is no search input and no filters anywhere in page.tsx or equipment-table.tsx.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: EquipmentTable maps items in data.ts order (EQ-1001, 1002, ...); no sort. Overdue EQ-1003 is third, EQ-2002 is eighth.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: InspectionNote renders 'Overdue by 3 days' and 'Due in 6 days' text under the date (visible in screenshot).

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: All dates via Intl.DateTimeFormat en-GB day-2-digit month-short year ('02 Nov 2026'); codes shown as 'EQ-1003 · Press' under each name. Minor: 'Sept' vs 'Jul' abbreviation lengths vary, but format is consistent.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: page.tsx dl summary line: 'Operational 11  In maintenance 2  Fault 2  Offline 1  Inspection overdue 2' (static text, not interactive tabs, but counts are shown).

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit: table-row-two-line, 16 of 16 rows double-line (name + code, date + note), row height ~61px. No row actions exist (target-size and icon-button-name not applicable), but single-line rows fail.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: No filters, no empty/no-results state, no loading.tsx or skeleton, no error state or retry in the source; items.map renders unconditionally.

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit text-contrast error x2: status Badge 'Fault' (rows 3 and 14) 3.97:1 vs 4.5:1. No interactive targets exist (smallTargets 0).

notes: Audit score 76 with violations text-contrast x2, radius-scale (10px table container, rounded-lg), table-row-two-line. Page rendered in Times New Roman (fontFamilies 'times new roman'), so the font stack/Tailwind font was not applied; the screenshot looks unstyled serif. Page is read-only: no search, filters, sorting, actions, or loading/empty/error states. Counts are static text. 'Overdue' counts only 2 (past-due) while due-soon is not counted. Tells are minimal otherwise: no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles, or avatars.
